source.name: Oklahoma City Thunder (nba.com): Thunder, Love's Enter Multi-Year Partnership Extension
source.quote: With the extension, the partnership will reach a longevity of 20 years – nine of which will include the Love's heart logo on Thunder jerseys.
source.note: The patch was first announced on 15 March 2019; this 2023 extension says nine years of the partnership include the Love's heart logo patch on Thunder jerseys, running from 2019 through 2027-28 and so covering 2026-27. The page body is JavaScript-rendered, so scripts/check_sources.py cannot read the quote.
